# Results

<!-- Generated by `python -m mlipft docs` from results/ and data/; edit src/mlipft/report.py. -->

Li transport of every model is compared with AIMD of the same ordered cell at the simulated temperatures ([protocol/amendments.md](../protocol/amendments.md) A3); forces and energies with the DFT labels. sigma(300 K) is the weighted Arrhenius extrapolation of the Nernst-Einstein conductivity, with the 1-sigma interval of the fit in brackets: it is conditional on these trajectories (one per temperature). Which value is quoted for each series (published in July 2026 or re-analysed) follows `protocol/reproduction_rule.md`; see [reproduction.md](reproduction.md). Measured conductivities are of S/Cl-disordered polycrystals, not of the ordered cell simulated here, and appear only as context for the universal potentials.

## B. Fine-tuned models against DFT

Label-error floor (Gamma-point labels against 2x2x2 labels, all 27 configurations): force RMSE 17.2 meV/A (Li 8.38, P 20.3, S 23.7, Cl 13.9); energy after removing the offset 0.43 meV/atom (the mean offset is 5.1 meV/atom); pressure 0.47 kbar.


On the three configurations held out by both fine-tunes (H3):

| Model | Drove an MD run | Force RMSE vs 2x2x2 (meV/A) | vs Gamma (meV/A) | Softening slope | Energy RMSE, offset removed (meV/atom) | Pressure RMSE (kbar) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| MACE-MP-0 (foundation) | yes | 216 | 220 | 0.812 | 8.2 | 0.70 |
| Fine-tuned, Gamma labels, stage one | no | 72.8 | 73.8 | 0.983 | 1.6 | 4.6 |
| Fine-tuned, Gamma labels, stage two | yes | 59.3 | 60.3 | 0.992 | 1.7 | 4.1 |
| Fine-tuned, 2x2x2 labels, stage one | yes | 70.3 | 73.2 | 0.987 | 1.4 | 4.0 |
| Fine-tuned, 2x2x2 labels, stage two | no | 57.1 | 60.3 | 0.988 | 1.8 | 4.4 |

## C. Transport: fine-tuned models against the foundation

416 atoms, 200 ps, re-analysis values for all three:

| Model | Ea (eV) | sigma(300 K) (mS/cm) | sigma / foundation |
|---|---|---|---|
| MACE-MP-0 (foundation) | 0.266 ± 0.012 | 5.54 [4.2, 7.3] | 1.0 |
| Fine-tuned, Gamma labels (stage two) | 0.335 ± 0.016 | 0.454 [0.31, 0.67] | 0.082 |
| Fine-tuned, 2x2x2 labels (stage one) | 0.360 ± 0.014 | 0.260 [0.19, 0.37] | 0.047 |


D of each fine-tuned model divided by D of the foundation:

| Model | T (K) | pymatgen | kinisi |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fine-tuned, Gamma labels (stage two) | 600 | 0.32 | 0.16 ± 0.04 |
| Fine-tuned, Gamma labels (stage two) | 800 | 0.43 | 0.41 ± 0.05 |
| Fine-tuned, Gamma labels (stage two) | 1000 | 0.54 | 0.55 ± 0.05 |
| Fine-tuned, 2x2x2 labels (stage one) | 600 | 0.28 | 0.16 ± 0.03 |
| Fine-tuned, 2x2x2 labels (stage one) | 800 | 0.51 | 0.51 ± 0.06 |
| Fine-tuned, 2x2x2 labels (stage one) | 1000 | 0.58 | 0.58 ± 0.05 |


Reading fixed in `protocol/analysis_plan.md`: f = -0.22, ln(sigma_K / sigma_G) = -0.56 ± 0.51: **not explained**. The two fine-tuned runs used models from different training stages (Gamma labels: stage two; 2x2x2 labels: stage one).


Against AIMD (amendment A3), D at 800 and 1000 K is 5.1 and 3.2 times the AIMD value for MACE-MP-0 (foundation); 2.1 and 1.8 times the AIMD value for Fine-tuned, Gamma labels (stage two); 2.6 and 1.9 times the AIMD value for Fine-tuned, 2x2x2 labels (stage one). The slowdown that fine-tuning causes moves D towards AIMD.
